description: The Excel certification evidence contract. tools/Certify-EXCEL_UI.ps1 reads it to name the bundle files, record the steps and run the certification runner; tools/check_excel_evidence.py reads it to validate a bundle. evidence_schema is the schema the bundle documents carry; required_files maps each role to its file name in the bundle; evidence_files are the files the workbook writes and session.json records digests for; steps are the steps the script records, in the order it runs them; host_fields are the host.json fields that must be non-empty text, and excel_matches_certification pairs each Excel field with the certification.json key it must equal. docs/EXCEL_CERTIFICATION.md describes the contract, and tests/test_excel_evidence_policy.py fails when the script, the validator or that guide disagrees with this file.
